description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to find the IDs of all clusters in a region.

description.zh: 查询可以在指定Region创建从集群的GDN列表。
description.en: Returns only GDNs that support creating a secondary cluster in the specified region.

description.zh:
GDN描述。要求如下：

- 不能以http://或https://开头。

- 必须以大小写字母或中文开头。

- 可以包含大小写字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）或连字符（-）。

- 长度为2~126个字符。
description.en:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

- It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

description.zh: 页码。默认值为1，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值。
description.en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
每页记录数。默认值为30，取值如下：

  - 30
  - 50
  - 100
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 30. Valid values:

- 30

- 50

- 100

title.zh: 查看所有全球数据库网络（GDN）详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-global-database-networks --filter-region cn-beijing --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --gdn-description test --gdn-id gdn-0000000000000000 --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
